import asyncio
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--query", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    screenshots_dir = output_dir / "screenshots"
    screenshots_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    log_file = output_dir / "final_script_log.txt"
    log_lines = []
    
    def log(step, action):
        log_lines.append(f"step {step} action: {action}")
    
    query = args.query
    limit = args.limit
    
    log(0, f"params: query={query!r}, limit={limit}")
    
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()
        
        # Step 1: Navigate to arXiv homepage
        await page.goto("https://arxiv.org/", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        log(1, "Navigate to arXiv homepage")
        
        # Save before.png showing the search page
        await page.screenshot(path=str(screenshots_dir / "before.png"))
        
        # Step 2: Click Form Interface to access advanced search
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Form Interface").click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
        log(2, "Click Form Interface to access advanced search")
        
        # Step 3: Enter search term
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search term").fill(query)
        log(3, f"Enter search query: {query!r}")
        
        # Step 4: Select "All fields" for search
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Field to search").select_option("All fields")
        log(4, "Select 'All fields' for search scope")
        
        # Step 5: Click Search button
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        log(5, "Submit search query")
        
        # Step 6: Sort by Relevance to get most relevant results
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Sort results by").select_option("Relevance")
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Go").click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        log(6, "Sort results by Relevance")
        
        # Step 7: Extract paper titles and abstract links using CSS selectors
        results = []
        
        # Get all list items containing papers
        list_items = page.locator("ol > li")
        count = await list_items.count()
        
        for i in range(min(limit, count)):
            item = list_items.nth(i)
            
            # Get the arXiv ID link from p.list-title a
            arxiv_link = item.locator("p.list-title a").first
            arxiv_id = await arxiv_link.inner_text()
            arxiv_href = await arxiv_link.get_attribute("href")
            
            # Get the title from p.title
            title_elem = item.locator("p.title").first
            title = await title_elem.inner_text()
            
            # Build the abstract URL
            if arxiv_href and arxiv_href.startswith("https://"):
                abstract_url = arxiv_href
            else:
                # Construct from arxiv ID
                arxiv_num = arxiv_id.replace("arXiv:", "").strip()
                abstract_url = f"https://arxiv.org/abs/{arxiv_num}"
            
            results.append({
                "title": title,
                "abstract_link": abstract_url
            })
            log(7 + i, f"Extracted paper {i+1}: {title[:50]}...")
        
        # Save after.png showing the results
        await page.screenshot(path=str(screenshots_dir / "after.png"))
        log(8, "Save after.png showing search results")
        
        source_url = page.url
        
        await browser.close()
    
    # Write final result
    final_result = {
        "parameters": {
            "query": query,
            "limit": limit
        },
        "result": {
            "results": results
        },
        "source_url": source_url
    }
    
    log_lines.append(f"final result: {json.dumps(final_result)}")
    
    with open(log_file, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(log_lines))
    
    print(json.dumps(final_result, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--query", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    screenshots_dir = output_dir / "screenshots"
    screenshots_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    log_file = output_dir / "final_script_log.txt"
    log_lines = []
    
    # Log params
    params = {"query": args.query, "limit": args.limit}
    log_lines.append(f"step 0 action: params: {json.dumps(params)}")
    
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 1800})
        page = await context.new_page()
        
        # Navigate to arXiv search page
        search_url = f"https://arxiv.org/search/?query={args.query.replace(' ', '+')}&searchtype=all&abstracts=show&order=-announced_date_first&size=50"
        await page.goto(search_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        
        # Save before screenshot
        await page.screenshot(path=str(screenshots_dir / "before.png"))
        log_lines.append("step 1 action: navigated to arXiv search page and saved before.png")
        
        # Wait for results to load
        await page.wait_for_selector(".arxiv-result", timeout=30000)
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        
        # Save after screenshot
        await page.screenshot(path=str(screenshots_dir / "after.png"))
        log_lines.append("step 2 action: search results loaded and saved after.png")
        
        # Extract paper results
        results = []
        paper_elements = await page.query_selector_all(".arxiv-result")
        
        for i, paper in enumerate(paper_elements[:args.limit]):
            # Get title
            title_elem = await paper.query_selector(".title.is-5")
            title = await title_elem.inner_text() if title_elem else ""
            title = title.strip()
            
            # Get abstract link (first link in list-title)
            link_elem = await paper.query_selector(".list-title a[href^='https://arxiv.org/abs/']")
            abstract_link = await link_elem.get_attribute("href") if link_elem else ""
            
            results.append({"title": title, "abstract_link": abstract_link})
            log_lines.append(f"step 3 action: extracted paper {i+1}: {title[:50]}...")
        
        await browser.close()
    
    # Write final result
    final_result = {
        "parameters": params,
        "result": {"results": results},
        "source_url": search_url
    }
    log_lines.append(f"final result: {json.dumps(final_result)}")
    
    # Write log file
    with open(log_file, "w") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(log_lines))
    
    print("Script completed successfully")
    print(json.dumps(final_result, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--query", type=str, required=True, help="Search query")

        with open(log_file, "a") as f:

        # Step 4: Set field to "All fields"
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Field to search").select_option("All fields")
        with open(log_file, "a") as f:
            f.write("step 3 action: set field to search to 'All fields'\n")
        
        # Step 5: Click Search button
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        with open(log_file, "a") as f:
            f.write("step 4 action: clicked Search button\n")
        
        # Capture source URL

        # Step 6: Take after screenshot
        await page.screenshot(path=str(screenshots_dir / "after.png"))
        with open(log_file, "a") as f:
            f.write("step 5 action: captured results page screenshot\n")

    def log_step(step, action):

            f.write(f"step {step} action: {action}\n")
    
    results = []
    source_url = ""
    
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:

        log_step(4, "Select 'All fields' for search field")
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Field to search").select_option("All fields")

        log_step(5, "Submit search query")
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first.click()

        # Step 5: Extract results
        log_step(6, f"Extract first {limit} paper titles and abstract links")
        
        # Find all result items - they are <li> elements inside <ol>
        result_items = page.locator("ol > li")
        count = await result_items.count()
        
        for i in range(min(limit, count)):

            # Extract title
            title_elem = item.locator(".title").first
